title: Pure Chimera
match: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
summary: Pure Chimera Fusion strategy utilizing the 2023 Illusion and Fiend/Beast support wave alongside generic staples. Big-Winged Berfomet, Mirror Swordknight, and Cornfield Coatl seamlessly tutor Chimera Fusion to assemble multi-negate boards, hand rips, and OTK beatdown with Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mirror Swordknight tributes itself as a Quick Effect to Special Summon any monster that mentions Chimera Fusion directly from the Deck (such as Big-Winged Berfomet).
Cornfield Coatl discards itself from hand to search any monster that mentions Chimera Fusion from Deck to hand.
Big-Winged Berfomet on Normal or Special Summon searches both a Level 4 Beast monster (such as Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts) and Chimera Fusion from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mirror Swordknight
steps: Normal Summon Mirror Swordknight (or discard Cornfield Coatl to add Mirror Swordknight and Normal Summon it).
Tribute Mirror Swordknight to Special Summon Big-Winged Berfomet from your Deck.
Trigger Big-Winged Berfomet on summon to add Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts and Chimera Fusion from Deck to hand.
Activate Chimera Fusion to fuse Big-Winged Berfomet and Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts into Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts.
Trigger Big-Winged Berfomet in the GY to Special Summon an Illusion monster (such as Mirror Swordknight) and trigger Gazelle to add an Illusion monster or Berfomet from Deck to hand.
Activate Chimera Fusion in the GY to add itself back to hand while Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts is on your field.
During the End Phase, activate Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts to rip 1 random card from the opponent's hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts sends a random card from the opponent's hand to the GY in the End Phase, and banishes itself from the GY on the opponent's turn to Special Summon a Beast, Fiend, or Illusion monster from your GY.

Berfomet the Mythical King of Phantom Beasts on Fusion Summon sends a Beast, Fiend, or Illusion monster from Deck to GY, and banishes itself from the GY on the opponent's turn to revive a banished Beast, Fiend, or Illusion.
Chimera the Illusion Beast can attack monsters a number of times per battle phase equal to the number of materials used, reduces the ATK of any monster it battles to 0, and negates its effects.
Guardian Chimera draws cards and destroys opponent cards without targeting based on the number of materials used from hand and field.
Mirror Swordknight and Cornfield Coatl in the GY provide Quick Effect monster negation and targeting negation respectively while Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast is on your field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Chimera Fusion is a Quick-Play Spell that performs a Fusion Summon using monsters from hand or field (including at least one Beast or Fiend), and recurs itself to hand from the GY while you control Chimera.
Big-Winged Berfomet locks your Extra Deck summons into Fusion Monsters for the rest of the turn, reinforcing the pure Fusion gameplan.

main: Starter: searches a Level 4 Beast and Chimera Fusion; revives an Illusion as material.
Tributes itself for a Chimera Fusion monster from the Deck; negates a monster effect.
Discards to search a Chimera Fusion monster; negates targeting.

Level 4 Beast material; Chimera Fusion revives it.
Fiend material that searches Gazelle; Chimera Fusion revives it.
Quick-Play Fusion with a Beast or Fiend; returns or summons Gazelle and Berfomet.
